retrieval_skill.name: mechanism_anchored_interval_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve evidence that links a documented operational mechanism to its measurable outcome over an explicit disruption interval, while separately capturing the normal regime and any post-restoration transition pattern.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When a forecast may be affected by a known outage, lockout, depletion, closure, or other mechanism that constrains the target during a bounded future window.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search jointly for the affected target, disruption mechanism, supported start and end boundaries, measured target outcome during the interval, and target-specific normal and recovery periodicity; organize findings into latent-process and regime layers.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept an intervention claim only when reliable evidence identifies the same target, establishes the causal mechanism, supports the exact temporal window, and directly reports or unambiguously entails the target outcome; do not extend the effect beyond documented boundaries, and preserve exact-quote and provenance requirements.
